hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements a 1:1 ETH ↔ phiEth swap by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, taking the input from the PoolManager, calling phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert between ETH and phiEth, and settling the output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked.
